high_alert_reason: ISMP high-alert: depolarizing paralytic. Black-box risk of hyperkalemic arrest in at-risk patients (burns, crush injury, denervation, prolonged immobility, rhabdomyolysis). Malignant hyperthermia trigger.
adult_dose: RSI: 1.0–1.5 mg/kg IV push. Onset 30–60 sec; duration 5–10 min.
pediatric_dose: Infants: 2 mg/kg IV. Children: 1–2 mg/kg IV.
max_dose: Single RSI dose: 150 mg (total body weight).
indications: Rapid-sequence intubation when a short-duration paralytic is preferred (e.g., difficult-airway reassessment)
contraindications: History of malignant hyperthermia (personal or family)
Hyperkalemia-precipitating conditions: acute renal failure with K+ elevation, denervation injuries
key_monitoring: Core temperature (MH early signs: masseter rigidity, tachycardia, rising etCO2)
Train-of-four returning to 4/4 before re-dosing or alternative paralytic

provenance.source: ACLS RSI algorithm + FDA black-box warning + ISMP high-alert list
provenance.note: Rocuronium preferred when any hyperkalemia or MH concern exists.
